message.content:
**Short answer:** Yes – you can file a noise complaint in Atlanta, but it’s usually handled by the **City of Atlanta Code Enforcement** or the **Atlanta Police Department**, not directly by the city council. The council can refer you to the appropriate department or help pass new ordinances, but the day‑to‑day enforcement is done by city staff. --- ## How to File a Noise Complaint in Atlanta | Step | What to Do | Where to Go / Who to Call | |------|------------|---------------------------| | 1 | **Check the Noise Ordinance** | Atlanta’s Noise Ordinance (Title 20, Chapter 1, Section 20.1.1) sets the legal limits for residential and commercial noise. Knowing the rule helps you describe the problem accurately. | | 2 | **Gather Details** | • Date & time of the disturbance
• Exact location (address or intersection)
• Description of the noise (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs)
• How long it has been happening
• Any prior attempts to resolve it (talking to the neighbor, etc.) | | 3 | **File Online** | • Visit the City of Atlanta’s **311** portal:
• Select “Noise Complaint” or “Code Enforcement” and fill out the form. | | 4 | **Call 311** | • Phone: **404‑656‑3111** (or dial **311** from any Atlanta phone).
• The dispatcher will log your complaint and forward it to the appropriate department. | | 5 | **Contact the Police (if urgent)** | • Atlanta Police Department: **404‑656‑3111** (same as 311) or 911 for emergencies.
• For ongoing or severe disturbances, the police can issue a citation or order the source to stop. | | 6 | **Follow Up** | • You’ll receive a case number. Keep it handy for any follow‑up calls or emails.
• If the issue isn’t resolved within a reasonable time, you can ask for an update or request a site visit. | --- ## Who Handles Noise Complaints? | Department | Role | |------------|------| | **City of Atlanta Code Enforcement** | Investigates violations of city ordinances, including noise. They can issue warnings, fines, or orders to cease the disturbance. | | **Atlanta Police Department** | Handles immediate or emergency noise issues, especially if the noise is part of a larger disturbance or involves illegal activity. | | **City Council** | Sets and amends ordinances. If you feel the current noise ordinance is inadequate, you can bring the issue to your local council member’s office or attend a council meeting to discuss changes. | --- ## Useful Links & Contacts | Resource | Link | |----------|------| | City of Atlanta 311 Portal | | | Atlanta Police Department | | | City Code Enforcement | | | Noise Ordinance (PDF) | | | Contact City Council Member | Find your council member at | --- ### Quick Tips 1. **Use the 311 portal** – it’s the fastest way to log a complaint and get a case number. 2. **Be specific** – the more detail you give, the easier it is for enforcement to act. 3. **Know the ordinance** – if you’re unsure whether the noise violates the law, the 311 dispatcher can explain. 4. **Escalate if needed** – if the problem persists, ask for a site visit or a formal citation. --- **Bottom line:** While the city council doesn’t directly process noise complaints, you can certainly file one through the city’s official channels (311, Code Enforcement, or Police). If you’re looking to influence policy, bring the issue to your local council member’s office.
